title: Myst Cult
content: Anyone else seen Myst Cult on Facebook Reels? I think they go by Myst.cult on some other platform. Those videos are trippy AF and really eerily familiar. The red carpets and the TVs really resonate with me. Also “The Archive in Between” has some surreal stuff going on too and recently put out a mall world video. Figured you guys would like it and I haven’t seen it posted on here so check it out. Definitely some dreamy familiar alternate dimension vibes.
